description: This Python test script scans project directories 'litellm' and 'enterprise' for hardcoded occurrences of 'litellm.set_verbose = True' assignments in Python source files, raising errors or assertions if such violations are found. It is designed to enforce best practices by preventing explicit setting of verbose mode in code, recommending configuration or environment-variable-based approaches instead.

methods.name: find_set_verbose_assignments(file_path)
methods.description: Parses a Python file to locate assignments of 'litellm.set_verbose = True' and returns their line numbers and text.

methods.name: scan_litellm_files(base_dir)
methods.description: Traverses specified directories, finds Python files, and reports any 'set_verbose' assignments that violate the policy.

methods.name: test_no_hardcoded_set_verbose()
methods.description: Pytest-compatible test function that asserts no forbidden 'set_verbose' assignments exist in the project.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Orchestrates scanning of the directories and reports violations, raising exceptions if any are found.
